summary: Hafnia Limited filed a Form 6-K announcing registration of a share capital increase tied to a previously priced offering of 35,488,875 ordinary shares raising gross proceeds of approximately USD 300 million, priced on 24 September 2026. The new shares were issued to a settlement agent to redeliver borrowed shares to BW Group Limited under a share lending agreement facilitating delivery-versus-payment settlement. Post-issuance, 535,331,154 ordinary shares are outstanding. Fearnley Securities, Pareto Securities, Arctic Securities and Clarksons Securities acted as managers. This is a routine follow-on equity issuance settlement notice, not a special situation; watch for potential BW Group overhang and trading liquidity on Euronext Oslo and NYSE.
